data.source: Yahoo Finance daily OHLCV via yfinance (auto_adjust=True: split and dividend adjusted)

protocol.validation: purged walk-forward, 5 time-ordered folds, expanding training window
protocol.purge: training rows are dated at least one label horizon before the evaluated block, and their label windows end before it starts
protocol.final_test: most recent 15% of labelled sessions per horizon, scored once after the configuration was frozen
protocol.edge_rule: rank IC > 0 on average and in >= 4 of 5 folds, > 0 on the final test, and Newey-West t-stat >= 2 over all out-of-sample days

weekly.target_description: rises more than 0.5% over the horizon

edge.rule: rank IC > 0 on average and in >= 4 of the walk-forward folds, > 0 on the final test, and Newey-West t-stat >= 2 over all out-of-sample days

baseline.description: LightGBM, 31 leaves, 400 trees, 26 features chosen by the old selection step

originally_reported.caveats: 4 walk-forward folds without a label-end purge; the test rows included the NIFTY 50 index as a stock; the weekly feature set was selected using the validation folds

previous_deployed_model.note: refit on every labelled row including this test period, so this AUC is in-sample
